name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Avatar: a small square panel (2px ink frame), pictures in greyscale, initials in lettering on paper. Badge is a small ink square; groups overlap with a paper gap; the group count is an ink flat.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/avatar". It wraps your own components/ui/avatar, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A square panel for a face or initials.
meta.usage:
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from "@/components/ui/manga/avatar"

<Avatar>
  <AvatarImage src="/me.png" alt="" />
  <AvatarFallback>NO</AvatarFallback>
</Avatar>
